# 3Dmol.js 2.5.5

Unmodified release bundle from:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/3dmol@2.5.5/build/3Dmol-min.js

Project: https://github.com/3dmol/3Dmol.js/tree/2.5.5

`3Dmol-LICENSE.txt` is the project's license, including its third-party notices.
`3Dmol-bundle-LICENSE.txt` contains the minified bundle's dependency notices.
Both notices are embedded in the generated HTML report, along with the bundle's
SHA-256 checksum. The report runs without a CDN connection.
